name: Our Name Is Mud Nurse Uniform Stoneware Mug (16 oz)
seoTitle: Our Name Is Mud Nurse Uniform Coffee Mug
metaDescription: A 16 oz blue stoneware mug from Our Name Is Mud with a nurse uniform design. A cheerful coffee gift for Nurses Week, a birthday, or a coworker swap.
summary: A cheerful blue stoneware mug shaped around a nurse uniform design, sized for the big coffee that gets a nurse through a long shift.
whyItWorks: Coffee is practically part of the uniform for a lot of nurses, so a mug that looks like the uniform itself is a fun, fitting gift. Our Name Is Mud is known for whimsical, hand drawn style ceramics, and this one gives a nod to the profession without leaning on tired slogans.

The 16 oz size is generous, which matters when the coffee has to last through report and the first round of meds, or when it is the first thing poured after waking up for night shift. Stoneware has a sturdy, substantial feel that makes it a kitchen favorite rather than a novelty that gets pushed to the back of the cabinet. It works well for Nurses Week, a birthday, or a Secret Santa gift. Add a bag of locally roasted beans or a gift card to a nearby coffee shop to round it out.
goodToKnow: Check the listing for microwave and dishwasher care instructions, since the title does not state them.
The design is playful rather than sentimental, so it suits a nurse with a sense of humor.
It is meant for home or the break room, not for carrying around the unit.

faq.q: Is this a good Secret Santa gift for a nurse?
faq.a: Yes, it is a safe, fun choice most nurses will actually use for their daily coffee.

faq.q: Is it suitable for a male nurse?
faq.a: Look at the listing photos for the uniform design to make sure it matches the recipient's style.
